title: A prelude to the theory of Real-World Asset (RWA) Tokenization
abstract: arXiv:2609.15797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We provide an introduction to real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, and develop two economic models connecting this emerging market to classical financial theory. In search for a theory of RWA tokenization, we classify RWA tokenization according to the role of the underlying asset, distinguishing standard RWA tokenization, stablecoins, and Digital Asset Treasuries (DATs). Our first model connects tokenization with security design under asymmetric information. Continuous secondary-market trading generates information recovery, reducing adverse-selection costs over time and affecting both the issuance price and the optimal tokenization design. Our second model develops a dynamic corporate-finance framework for DATs, in which market valuation, capital-market financing, and crypto accumulation interact endogenously. translated_title: 现实世界资产（RWA）代币化理论之序曲
translated_abstract: 本文对现实世界资产（RWA）代币化进行了介绍，并建立了两个将这一新兴市场与经典金融理论相联系的经济学模型。在探索RWA代币化理论的过程中，我们根据底层资产的角色对RWA代币化进行分类，区分了标准RWA代币化、稳定币和数字资产财库（DATs）。我们的第一个模型将代币化与非对称信息下的证券设计相联系：持续的二级市场交易产生信息恢复，随时间推移降低逆向选择成本，并同时影响发行价格和最优代币化设计。我们的第二个模型为DATs建立了一个动态公司金融框架，其中市场估值、资本市场融资和加密资产积累内生地相互作用。我们刻画了最优发行政策，并以Strategy公司为案例对模型进行了说明。最后提出了若干未来研究方向。
tldr: 本文为RWA代币化构建理论框架，按底层资产角色将其分为标准代币化、稳定币和数字资产财库三类，并提出两个模型：一个将代币化与非对称信息下的证券设计相联系，另一个为数字资产财库建立动态公司金融框架以刻画最优发行政策。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theory of RWA tokenization by classifying it into standard tokenization, stablecoins, and Digital Asset Treasuries (DATs), presenting two models: one linking tokenization to security design under asymmetric information, and a dynamic corporate-finance framework for DATs that characterizes the optimal issuance policy.
